hadith_text: "When a person dies, his deeds come to an end except for three: ongoing charity, knowledge from which others benefit, and a righteous child who prays for him."
quran_desc: Read, listen, and reflect on the words of Allah. Every letter recited is a reward for the deceased.
adhkar_desc: Remember Allah with morning and evening supplications. Use our digital tasbih to keep count.
best_of_you: "The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it."
spiritual_statement: All spiritual activities on this platform are offered purely for the sake of Allah, as a continuous charity for our beloved brother. We ask you to keep him in your sincere duas.
footer_text: This platform is dedicated to ongoing good deeds. May Allah accept it and grant him the highest ranks in Jannah.
mission_statement: This platform, "Sadaqa Jariya Waqf", was created with a single, pure intention: to serve as a continuous stream of good deeds for our beloved brother.
non_profit_desc: This project is entirely dedicated to Allah. There are no ads, no fees, and no commercial interests.
continuous_reward_desc: Every letter you read and every tasbih you count contributes to the legacy of Sadaqa Jariya.
gallery_desc: In memory of the deceased, may Allah have mercy on him
may_allah_mercy: May Allah have mercy on him
supplications_subtitle: Authentic supplications for the deceased (May Allah have mercy on him)
quran_source_note: Quran Text Source: King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex in Uthmani Script (Hafs from Asim via Tanzil Project) | English Translation: Sahih International
gift_toast: May Allah accept your recitation and grant its rewards to Tadjeddine Mezioud.
